page.notes: The catchword "dis" stands alone at the lower right. The marginal note "Dammona ab excidio seruata" is partly blurred; "seruata" is uncertain. The word "ipso ac" in the text is hard to read and may be a run-together of "ipsoque". The lower margin note is "Conditiones Burgundicae", with the last word uncertain. "die VI" is read as Roman numerals.
